title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Sarah Frazier is a Partner at WilmerHale where she has a diverse litigation practice with an emphasis on high-stakes trials. While she focuses her practice on intellectual property litigation, she has played critical roles in numerous trials across a range of substantive areas.
